title: Summarize delivered orders
prompt: Return one row with two columns: orders, the number of delivered orders, and revenue, the total of quantity * unit_price over the items of those orders.
hints: After joining orders to their items, what does one row stand for?
The revenue needs every item row. The order count must count each order once.
count(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders, sum(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue

wrongAnswers.misconception: Counts item rows and reports them as orders.
Joins a table the question does not need, which repeats the items.

feedback: Test the order count with a plain query on orders alone. It must give the same number.
